To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the future of work is likely to bring new challenges to OSH research and practice, including a need for new methods to address these challenges, and a need for new approaches to engage key stakeholders in research and policy making.

the future of work will require a paradigm shift in OSH that embraces key stakeholders, thinks differently about research and practice, and integrates the skills of OSH research disciplines with broader methods that support a transdisciplinary character.

the well being of workers and the sustainability of enterprises.
how the changing world of work affects worker health and safety.
the health and safety of workers in the workplace and the health, well-being and safety of people at work.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the future of work will require a paradigm shift in OSH research to better understand the effects of new and emerging workplace health and safety challenges and the impact of changing work arrangements on worker health, well being, and safety.
the future of OSH will require a paradigm shift to address the new challenges and opportunities presented by the future of work.
the future of work will shape OSH research and practice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the future of work will require a more transdisciplinary research approach to OSH that embraces the needs of a diverse workforce in a global context.

OSH research needs to expand beyond the traditional focus on hazards and injuries to include a more comprehensive focus that addresses the health and safety needs of all workers, including the social determinants of worker health and safety, the well being of the worker, and the well being of enterprise.
we have a long way to go in order to develop a transdisciplinary research agenda that will address the OSH challenges of the future of work.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a paradigm shift will be required for OSH research that embraces key stakeholders in the workplace and thinks differently about OSH research that will improve the health and well being of workers and enhance the enterprise success.
the future of work will be shaped by the decisions we make today.
the future of OSH research must be proactive, transdisciplinary, and inclusive to ensure a healthy, safe, and productive workplace.
